'''2003 Quebec Provincial Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG provincial championship in Montreal (13 April 2003). [[Raphael Asselin]] was the qualifier.<ref name="pc-intl03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040621085705/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Nationals and Provincials (International Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 21 June 2004.</ref> On 18 April 2003 the Players Committee declared Asselin the 2003 Quebec Provincial Champion.<ref name="pc-qcruling" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Montreal
* '''Dates:''' 13 April 2003<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Venue:''' University of Quebec, Montreal<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Time:''' 9am<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Fee:''' $5<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' Patrick Dinelle<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Qualifier:''' [[Raphael Asselin]]<ref name="pc-intl03" />

== Players Committee ruling ==

After a controversy over the outcome of the event, the [[Players Committee]] issued an official ruling on 18 April 2003, announced by Tournament Support Advocate [[Andrew Howard]].<ref name="pc-apr03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/april03archives.htm April Updates], swccgpc.com (18 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030810085606/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/april03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> It declared [[Raphael Asselin]] the 2003 Quebec Provincial Champion, with the bye into Day 2 of the [[2003 World Championship|World Championships]] and all the prizes due to the Provincial Champion. Patrick Dinelle was retroactively disqualified from the event and forfeited all prizes, including the title of Champion, the bye and the uncut sheet; his rating was to be adjusted after the tournament was updated.<ref name="pc-qcruling">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/quebecruling04182003.htm Committee's Official Ruling on Quebec Provincial], swccgpc.com (18 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030612201254/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/quebecruling04182003.htm Internet Archive]</ref> The event stayed sanctioned so that the players who had spent time and money to attend were not punished. The Committee urged all tournament directors to follow the Tournament Guidelines and Code of Conduct, and said that future breaches of official rules would not be given the same leniency.<ref name="pc-qcruling" />
